name: Bodhi Starwater
reason: No usable own site: bodhistarwater.com is a parked lander and soundsofbodhi.com says 'coming soon' (4 Nov 2026). The only live site, starwaterandsol.com, is a duo music act's page (Starwater & Sol, with Christopher Sol Parnell) listing past concerts and albums, and its sound-healing course page returned 403 to us (CloudFront block), so we stopped fetching it. Too little that is his own, current and reachable, and the live site is a music project rather than a teacher's page; his book '5 Elements of Sound Healing' could not be confirmed from his own or the publisher's site.
